title: HJ numbers revisited
summary: We improve the bounds on the Hales-Jewett numbers to a tower of exponentiations. Earlier it was $WaW$ (that is, iterations of towers which are themselves iterated exponentiations). We improve the inductive step there (induction on the size of the alphabet, $|Λ|$) to 2-exponentiations, instead of towers. In the longer work in typing, (A) We present this inductive step as a partition theorem in its own right; (but in this preliminary version we make it just serve the bound on HJ numbers).
